notes.title: SAYING GOODBYE
notes.content:
The end of September is near, and with it, I’m rolling away, chasing my fortune to another place :coin:
It’s been an incredible adventure with all of you, and I’ve come to realize that the real treasure is this amazing community 

Before I bounce off into the sunset (hopefully without hitting any spike traps), I want to thank you for the laughs, support, and unforgettable moments. You’ve made this journey truly priceless! or the laughs, 
Take care, and remember: like Leo, always bounce back!

With gratitude,
Leopold the Fortunate

notes.title: Speedrun Canceled
notes.content:
Dear Leo’s Fortune Community,

We are truly sorry to inform you that, due to unforeseen circumstances that compromised the integrity of the contest, we have had to make the difficult and regrettable decision to cancel the Leo's Fortune Speedrun Contest. One of the main reasons for this outcome has been the low number of participants.
We fully understand how disappointing and frustrating this news may be for those who were excited and prepared to compete, and for this, we offer our most sincere apologies. Canceling the event was not a decision we took lightly, and we deeply regret any inconvenience or upset this has caused within our community.

Please know that we are incredibly grateful for your enthusiasm, and we truly appreciate the effort of everyone who participated or supported this event. Your continued loyalty to Leo's Fortune means a lot to us!

Once again, we are deeply sorry for this unfortunate event. If you have any questions, concerns, or feedback, please do not hesitate to reach out to us directly.
Thank you for your understanding and for being a valued part of this community.

With our deepest and sincerest apologies,

The Leo's Fortune Team.
